This lack of explicit chunking logic explains why the test `testLongLineChunkingIndentIgnored` fails when attempting to print long descriptions. The description text is not chunked into appropriate lines based on the specified width.

It seems like the bug lies in the missing chunking logic within the `printHelp` method of the `HelpFormatter` class. The method should have additional logic to properly chunk long descriptions to fit within the specified width.
